facts.text: Downtown Sacramento’s historic Capitol Mall once mirrored a street grid, but today it hosts the California State Capitol building, the state’s government hub.
The Sacramento Valley Amtrak Station, just north of Downtown Commons, is the western terminus of the Gold Line light rail and serves the Capitol Corridor.
K Street, once Sacramento’s main shopping artery, was closed to cars in 1969, reopened only for a four‑block stretch in 2011, and now functions as a pedestrian mall called The Kay.
Downtown’s Downtown Commons, or DOCO, anchors the area with Macy’s, the Sawyer Hotel, and the Golden 1 Center, the home arena of the Sacramento Kings.
The Cathedral of the Blessed Sacrament, located at 11th and K Streets, is the largest historical cathedral west of the Sacramento River.
